name: Stick-on bindi (face jewel)
definition: decorative jewel or ornament stuck on the forehead or skin with adhesive, not fixed by chain, pin or piercing.
notes: Listing titled Indian crystal wedding bindis, stick on, forehead jewel; sold in packs of 15.

name: Surface bar
definition: staple-shaped bar with two upturned ends, made for a surface piercing.
notes: Tilum surface barbell: two opposing 90 degree posts, one at each end, with ball tops.

name: Hinged segment ring (clicker)
definition: piercing ring closed by a hinged segment that clicks into place.
notes: Steel Hinged Clicker Ring sold as easier-to-fit alternative to the standard segment ring.

name: Circular barbell (horseshoe)
definition: open ring-shaped bar with a threaded or pressed ball or end at each tip.
notes: Steel horseshoe circular barbell, 316L, 16G, ball ends, sold as a pair.

name: Ear hanger or weight
definition: heavy hanging piece hooked through a stretched lobe, worn instead of a plug or tunnel.
notes: Hoop hangers for stretched piercings, heavy enough to act as ear weights; spring-loaded clasp.

name: Statement necklace (bib necklace)
definition: necklace built of large fixed ornamental elements, stones or metalwork along its front, not hung from a bail and not a bead strand.
notes: Bloomingdales Statement Necklaces category (Nadri, Lagos, Ettika); mixes cluster, link and bar necklaces.

name: Tennis necklace (rivière)
definition: flexible line of evenly set stones worn round the neck.
notes: Round diamonds 3-prong set in 18K white gold, 17 in, 10.17 cttw; also VRAI Tennis Necklace at Bloomingdales.

name: Hat pin
definition: long ornamental pin with a decorative head, pushed through a hat to hold it to the hair.
notes: 1stDibs category Antique Long Hat Pins; Victorian to Art Nouveau pins with jewelled heads, 7 to 11 in.

name: Shirt stud (dress stud)
definition: ornamental stud that fastens a formal shirt front or a detachable collar through its buttonholes (collar studs included).
notes: Fort Belvedere monkey fist shirt studs for evening shirts, sold individually.

name: Luggage tag
definition: Tag fixed to a bag or suitcase to show its owner's name and address.
notes: Samsonite personalised luggage tag; Tumi Alpha leather luggage tag holds business card or ID.

name: Watch clasp or buckle
definition: Buckle or folding (deployant) clasp made to close a watch strap or bracelet.
notes: Esslinger sells stainless deployant buckle with push button, 16-20mm, replacing a standard strap buckle.

name: Watch spring bar
definition: Spring-loaded bar made to hold a strap or bracelet between a watch case's lugs.
notes: Long Island Watch Spring Bars collection: pairs in 20, 22, 24mm, double flange and fat Seiko types.

name: Hookah windcover
definition: Perforated cover set over a hookah bowl and its coals to shield them from wind.
notes: Listing titled Windcover Bowl + Screen for Egyptian hookah; cover sold with bowl and screen.

name: Pipe tamper
definition: Small tool for pressing down burning tobacco in a pipe bowl.
notes: 1950s Dunhill pocket tamper tool, brass, steel, vulcanite; antiques dealer listing, tamper for pipe tobacco.

name: Pipe cleaner
definition: Absorbent wire-cored cleaner made for cleaning a pipe's stem and shank.
notes: Zen hard bristle pipe cleaners, pack of 3; smokingpipes blog compares BJ Long, Peterson, Brigham cleaners.

name: Pipe filter
definition: Charcoal, balsa or paper filter insert for a filter pipe.
notes: Box of 50 Savinelli 9mm balsa system filters, sold as pipe inserts.

name: Pipe stand [pipe rack]
definition: Stand or rack that holds tobacco pipes when not in use.
notes: MUXIANG wooden pipe stand rack for 4 briar pipes, sold new.

name: Filter tip [roach, crutch]
definition: Loose filter or card tip for a hand-rolled cigarette or joint.
notes: RAW Original Natural Tips, roll-your-own paper filter tips, 50 per pack, 59 x 17 mm.

name: Cigarette tube
definition: Empty filtered paper tube filled with fine-cut tobacco by an injector.
notes: Gambler Cigarette Filter Tubes Regular, 200 ct, at Costco Business Center.

name: Snuff box
definition: Small box for carrying snuff on the person.
notes: 1stDibs Antique Snuff Boxes category, 560 listings in horn, silver, enamel, wood; sold as collectibles.

name: Dried opium
definition: dried opium poppy product taken for a psychoactive effect (K-168; provisional until attested).
notes: USP monograph Powdered Opium: opium dried below 70 degrees and finely powdered; register entry, not a seller page.

name: Nicotine toothpick
definition: toothpick infused with nicotine.
notes: Vaping360 brand entry ZIPPIX nicotine toothpicks (released May 2019); nicotine and flavour infused toothpicks.

name: Psychoactive mushroom product
definition: dried psychoactive mushroom material (K-168; provisional until attested).
notes: Wild Forest Herbs sells dried Amanita muscaria whole caps, broken caps, powder; Soma Supplies sells dried muscaria and pantherina.
